53164-the-standard-bearer.title: The Standard Bearer
53164-the-standard-bearer.creator: Unknown
53164-the-standard-bearer.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. A book iron-grey and chill is this that I have written, the tale of times when the passions of men were still working like a yeasty sea after the storms of the Great Killing. If these pages should chance to be read when the leaves are greening, they may taste somewhat unseasonably in the mouth.

arxiv-2011-10389.title: Challenging the Security of Logic Locking Schemes in the Era of Deep Learning: A Neuroevolutionary Approach CCS: Security and privacy CCS: Security and privacy Security in hardware
arxiv-2011-10389.creator: Dominik Sisejkovic, Farhad Merchant, Lennart M. Reimann, Harshit Srivastava, Ahmed Hallawa, Rainer Leupers
arxiv-2011-10389.description: Abstract . Logic locking is a prominent technique to protect the integrity of hardware designs throughout the integrated circuit design and fabrication flow. However, in recent years, the security of locking schemes has been thoroughly challenged by the introduction of various deobfuscation attacks.

arxiv-2105-13870.title: Regret-Minimizing Bayesian Persuasion
arxiv-2105-13870.creator: Yakov Babichenko, Inbal Talgam-Cohen, Haifeng Xu, Konstantin Zabarnyi
arxiv-2105-13870.description: Abstract We study a Bayesian persuasion setting with binary actions ( adopt and reject ) for Receiver. We examine the following question – how well can Sender perform, in terms of persuading Receiver to adopt, when ignorant of Receiver’s utility?

arxiv-2108-01713.title: Recovery and analysis of rest-frame UV emission lines in 2052 galaxies observed with MUSE at 1.5 < z < 6.4 1.5<z<6.4 Thanks: The catalogs described in Appendix B (Table 7 ) and C (Table 8 ) are available in electronic form at the CDS via anonymous ftp to cdsarc.u-strasbg.fr (130.79.128.5) or via htt
arxiv-2108-01713.creator: K. B. Schmidt, J. Kerutt, L. Wisotzki, T. Urrutia, A. Feltre, M. V. Maseda, T. Nanayakkara, R. Bacon, L. A. Boogaard, S. Conseil, T. Contini, E. C. Herenz, W. Kollatschny, M. Krumpe, F. Leclercq G. Mahler, J. Matthee, V. Mauerhofer, J. Richard, and J. Schaye
arxiv-2108-01713.description: Abstract Rest-frame ultraviolet (UV) emission lines probe electron densities, gas-phase abundances, metallicities, and ionization parameters of the emitting star-forming galaxies and their environments. The strongest main UV emission line, Ly α \alpha , has been instrumental in advancing the general knowledge of galaxy formation in the early universe.

arxiv-2109-08382.title: To be Closer: Learning to Link up Aspects with Opinions
arxiv-2109-08382.creator: Yuxiang Zhou, Lejian Liao, Yang Gao, Zhanming Jie, Wei Lu
arxiv-2109-08382.description: Abstract Dependency parse trees are helpful for discovering the opinion words in aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) Huang and Carley 2019 . However, the trees obtained from off-the-shelf dependency parsers are static, and could be sub-optimal in ABSA. This is because the syntactic trees are not designed for capturing the interactions between opinion words and aspect words.

arxiv-2407-03825.title: StreamLTS: Query-based Temporal-Spatial LiDAR Fusion for Cooperative Object Detection
arxiv-2407-03825.creator: Yunshuang Yuan, Monika Sester
arxiv-2407-03825.description: Abstract Cooperative perception via communication among intelligent traffic agents has great potential to improve the safety of autonomous driving. However, limited communication bandwidth, localization errors and asynchronized capturing time of sensor data, all introduce difficulties to the data fusion of different agents.

arxiv-2407-21494.title: Towards Automated Continuous Security Compliance Conference: 18th ACM/IEEE International Symposium on Empirical Engineering and Measurement; October 20–25, 2024; Barcelona, Spain CCS: Security and privacy Software security engineering CCS: Software and its engineering Software verification and valid
arxiv-2407-21494.creator: Florian Angermeir, Jannik Fischbach, Fabiola Moyón, Daniel Mendez
arxiv-2407-21494.description: Abstract . Context: Continuous Software Engineering is increasingly adopted in highly regulated domains, raising the need for continuous compliance. Adherence to especially security regulations – a major concern in highly regulated domains – renders Continuous Security Compliance of high relevance to industry and research.

arxiv-2408-12972.title: Attractive-repulsive interaction in coupled quantum oscillators
arxiv-2408-12972.creator: Bulti Paul, Biswabibek Bandyopadhyay, Tanmoy Banerjee
arxiv-2408-12972.description: Abstract We study the emergent dynamics of quantum self-sustained oscillators induced by the simultaneous presence of attraction and repulsion in the coupling path. We consider quantum Stuart-Landau oscillators under attractive-repulsive coupling and construct the corresponding quantum master equation in the Lindblad form.

arxiv-2410-22312.title: Effective Guidance for Model Attention with Simple Yes-no Annotations
arxiv-2410-22312.creator: Seongmin Lee, Ali Payani, Duen Horng (Polo) Chau
arxiv-2410-22312.description: Abstract Modern deep learning models often make predictions by focusing on irrelevant areas, leading to biased performance and limited generalization. Existing methods aimed at rectifying model attention require explicit labels for irrelevant areas or complex pixel-wise ground truth attention maps.

pmc-10694161.title: Wastewater-based surveillance models for COVID-19: A focused review on spatio-temporal models
pmc-10694161.creator: Fatemeh Torabi, Guangquan Li, Callum Mole, George Nicholson, Barry Rowlingson, Camila Rangel Smith, Radka Jersakova, Peter J Diggle, Marta Blangiardo
pmc-10694161.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The evident shedding of the SARS-CoV-2 RNA particles from infected individuals into the wastewater opened up a tantalizing array of possibilities for prediction of COVID-19 prevalence prior to symptomatic case identification through community testing. Many countries have therefore explored the use of wastewater metrics as a surveillance tool, replacing traditional direct measurement of prevalence with cost-effective approaches based on SARS-CoV-2 RNA concentrations in wastewater samples.

pmc-10784822.title: Mutational separation and clinical outcomes of TP53 and CDH1 in gastric cancer
pmc-10784822.creator: He-Li Liu, Huan Peng, Chang-Hao Huang, Hai-Yan Zhou, Jie Ge
pmc-10784822.description: BACKGROUNDGastric cancer (GC) is a deadly tumor with the fifth highest occurrence and highest global mortality rates. Owing to its heterogeneity, the underlying mechanism of GC remains unclear, and chemotherapy offers little benefit to individuals.AIMTo investigate the clinical outcomes of TP53 and CDH1 mutations in GC.METHODSIn this study, 202 gastric adenocarcinoma tumor tissues and their corresponding normal tissues were collected.

pmc-11312859.title: A Narrative Review of the IL-18 and IL-37 Implications in the Pathogenesis of Atopic Dermatitis and Psoriasis: Prospective Treatment Targets
pmc-11312859.creator: Lluís Rusiñol, Lluís Puig
pmc-11312859.description: Atopic dermatitis and psoriasis are prevalent inflammatory skin conditions that significantly impact the quality of life of patients, with diverse treatment options available. Despite advances in understanding their underlying mechanisms, recent research highlights the significance of interleukins IL-18 and IL-37, in Th1, Th2, and Th17 inflammatory responses, closely associated with the pathogenesis of psoriasis and atopic dermatitis.

pmc-12609631.title: Fermented Chinese Herbs Improved Egg Production, Egg Shell Quality, and Egg Yolk Cholesterol of Laying Hens by Regulating Estrogen, Lipid Metabolism, and Calcium Metabolism
pmc-12609631.creator: Xinyu Liu, Yue He, Yuhan Cao, Xin Wang, Ye Yang, Jiao Song
pmc-12609631.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryEggshell quality and egg cholesterol content are important factors determining consumer acceptability and egg production efficiency. Use of Chinese herbal compounds is an efficient nutritional regulation means of modulating egg quality. In this study, we evaluated the effects of a specific Chinese herbal compound on egg production, egg shell quality, and egg yolk cholesterol by assessing its ability to regulate estrogen, lipid metabolism, and calcium metabolism.

pmc-12750898.title: Characteristics of patients repeatedly presenting to the emergency department for self-harm injuries: a 6-year retrospective study
pmc-12750898.creator: Kwang Yul Jung, Sejin Heo, Taerim Kim, Won Chul Cha
pmc-12750898.description: BackgroundSelf-harm is a risk factor for suicide completion, and repeated self-harm carries an even greater risk. This study aimed to assess the characteristics of patients who repeatedly presented to the emergency department (ED) for self-harm.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective analysis of data from the ED‑Based Injury In‑Depth Surveillance registry in South Korea from January 2017 to December 2022.

pmc-13243539.title: Analyzing bamboo-based enterprises in Injibara, Amhara Region, Northwest Ethiopia
pmc-13243539.creator: Assayech Agidew Bogale, Dagim Fikir Abate, Jigar Yirsaw, Adamu Worku Kassa, Amsalu Nigatu Alamerew
pmc-13243539.description: Bamboo has been recognized for its ecological, economic, and cultural importance in Ethiopia. However, bamboo-based enterprises remain underdeveloped and poorly understood, particularly in developing towns like Injibara. Limited research has been conducted on the characteristics, profitability, and growth prospects of bamboo-based enterprises. Such information is essential for evidence-based policy-making and sustainable development efforts.

pmc-13444293.title: Prediabetes and diabetes among patients presenting with acute stroke or acute coronary syndrome at a tertiary regional referral centre in Kenya
pmc-13444293.creator: Beverly Owino, Jasmit Shah, Hasina Visram, Eric Njenga, Nancy Kunyiha
pmc-13444293.description: BackgroundDiabetes and pre-diabetes are significant risk factors for acute coronary syndrome (ACS) and acute primary stroke (APS). Dysglycemia in any context is under-diagnosed or identified late in resource-poor countries such as in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), especially when the patient is not known to have pre-morbid diabetes.Materials and methodsWe conducted a prospective cross-sectional study at the Aga Khan University Hospital, Nairobi.
